title: Associative Recall Contract (Stage 2)
description: Request and response payload contracts for `sekha-cluster-tool recall`, dispatched to the Node 1 Long-Term Knowledge Graph Store (POST /api/v1/memory/recall, :8084). The response object is emitted verbatim to stdout by the CLI. Property names mirror the compiled tool's JSON tags exactly and must never be anglicised.

Node.description: A vertex in the relational knowledge graph.

entity_type.description: Ontological class of the entity (e.g. policy, device, event).

embedding.description: Optional dense vector; usually omitted from recall output.

access_count.description: Number of times the node has been recalled; feeds the frequency score.

stability_score.description: Hebbian stability; higher scores decay more slowly.

anchors.description: Anchor tags attached to the entity at consolidation time.

score.description: Composite recall score = alpha*sim_score + beta*frequency_score + gamma*recency_score.

hop_distance.description: Graph hops from the seed match (0 = direct hit, 1 = one-hop neighbour).

Edge.description: A directed, weighted relationship between two knowledge nodes.

relation_type.description: Semantics of the relationship (e.g. mitigates, causes, governs).

request.description: Payload dispatched to Node 1. Populated from the CLI flags --query, --top-k, --include-embeddings, --format, --anchor, --anchor-mode, --type and --min-score.

embedding.description: Optional precomputed query vector; supplied in place of --query.

entity_id.description: Optional direct entity anchor for neighbourhood expansion.

top_k.description: Maximum ranked nodes to return (CLI flag --top-k; defaults to CLUSTER_RECALL_TOP_K).

include_embeddings.description: When true (CLI flag --include-embeddings), returns 64-D vector floats; default false.

anchors.description: Target anchor tags for scoping recall (CLI flag --anchor / -a; repeatable or comma-delimited).

type.description: Entity type filter (CLI flag --type / -t; e.g. config, fact, policy).

response.description: Ranked contextual nodes and their relational subgraph.

nodes.description: Ranked associative entities, highest score first.

edges.description: Relational edges connecting the returned nodes.
